text:
elaine: Quick thread: proposing a long-lived refactor to pull prompt transforms + tenant rules out of runtime-host into a small sandboxed sidecar (WASM runtime). Goals: simplify runtime hotpath, enable per-tenant rules, and improve testability.

rohan: Sounds good. Two operational modes: colocated unix-socket sidecar for low-latency Dedicated pools, and multi-tenant HTTP pool for Hosted. Need clear latency SLOs per mode.

miguel: Agree. Also recommend module signing + immutable registry so we can trust tenant modules. No outbound network from modules.

elaine: Rollout idea: mirror-canary new module/version for a % of traffic and compute transform_diff_pct. If diff > 0.25% or p99 lat climbs > 25%, abort. Also include dry-run endpoint for product teams.

rohan: API surface: tiny RPC with fields {tenant_id, raw_prompt, profile_hint} -> {transformed_prompt, version_tag, patches}. gRPC default, JSON fallback. Include transform_version in response for traceability.

miguel: Implement read-only model-profile hints via cached reads. Sidecar should never write to profile store. Cache TTL and eviction metrics important.

elain: typo (elaine): Also add a last-good-cache: if module load fails, sidecar uses previous module or runtime native transform as fallback. Document automatic disable when module_crash_rate > threshold.

infra-bot: Added Helm chart stub, prometheus metrics: preprocess_latency_ms (p50/p95/p99), transform_diff_pct, module_crash_count, module_cache_hit_rate. Health probes required.

sec-bot: Security checklist: require artifact signatures, KMS-backed signing keys, audit log for publishes, tenant allowlist for custom modules. Default Hosted tenants only get Redwood-vetted modules.

rohan: Testing: unit tests in module CI, integration scenario running sidecar + runtime with synthetic corpus, and perf microbenchmarks per-module. We should store a sample corpus per tenant for dry-runs.

miguel: Perf targets proposal: local socket p50 <0.8ms, p99 <3ms; remote shared p50 <2ms, p99 <8ms. We'll measure per-module deltas and tune pooling.

elaine: I'll draft RFC w/ interface, signing/registry, canary rules, perf targets, deployment modes, and fallback semantics. Planning review with infra/sec next week. If objections to WASM sandbox approach please raise now. :eyes:
